high_level_description: stc brand style, a purple stc-branded mobile education trailer parked outdoors with rows of white chairs set up for an event.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A clear blue sky above a paved outdoor event area with a decorative white sculpture in the background.

elements.desc: A purple shipping-container-style trailer with white lettering reading an education program name and a lit window, accessed by a metal staircase.
Rows of white chairs arranged on a patterned red rug in front of the trailer, cordoned off with purple stanchion ropes.
White text on the purple trailer reading the program name, with an Arabic subtitle below it.
